issues.issue: Panel 2 flow is ambiguous: fold 1 and fold 5 both have arrows into the network/prediction row, and the fold-5 arrow lands on the last predicted digit, so it reads as 'fold 5 is one of the samples' rather than 'the network scores held-out fold 5'. The four fold-1..4 blocks are not visibly the training data.
issues.fix: Draw one bracket under folds 1-4 pointing to the network card ('fit on 4') and one arrow from fold 5 to the row of predicted samples labeled 'predict fold 5'; drop the arrow from fold 1 alone. Optionally label the row 'held-out fold'.

issues.issue: Panel 3 does not show the problem at a glance: the dashed clean-level line is not explained in the figure, and on Breast cancer at 40% the filter bar (about 84) barely beats logistic regression (about 80) with huge overlapping error bars, so the headline 'filter stays near clean, others fall' is only convincing on Digits.
issues.fix: Add a tiny in-panel label for the dashed line ('clean accuracy of filter') or mention it in the caption; keep the data honest but add one phrase in the caption that Breast cancer 40% has wide seed spread. Consider enlarging panel 3 slightly (shrink panel 1 or 2) since it carries the result.

issues.issue: Digit thumbnails are italic serif glyphs, not dataset images, and the caption does not say so; at 'top venue' standard a reader will see them as fake.
issues.fix: Use real sklearn digit images (8x8, upscaled, grayscale) for the thumbnails, or state in the caption that thumbnails are schematic. Keep the tag numbers matching the shown image.

issues.issue: Stacked precision bar: the clean segment has no percentage and the flipped segment has a red outline while the spec and the legend put red only on tags; the sentence above reads 'truly flipped: 71%' but the bar sits far from the crosses it summarizes.
issues.fix: Label segments 'flipped 71%' and 'clean 29%' (computed from PREC), use a purple outline only, and add a thin connector or bracket from the crossed samples to the bar.

issues.issue: Panel 1 shows the flips but not the accuracy drop; the 'flipped tag' legend sits far below the grid and the 4x6 grid is dense with tiny 7 pt tags.
issues.fix: Add a short note '~20-40% flipped' under the grid, move the legend next to the grid's top-right or directly under it, and give the tag boxes a bit more size.

issues.issue: Axis label 'test accuracy (%, from 50)' and x labels 'Digits, noise (%)' are cramped; groups lack a clear dataset title and the right group has no y ticks, so the 50 start is easy to miss on Breast cancer.
issues.fix: Put 'Digits' and 'Breast cancer' as small titles above each group, keep 'noise (%)' as a shared x label, and draw faint 50/75/100 grid labels on both groups or a clear axis-break note in the caption.

issues.issue: Caption draft omits that the y axis starts at 50% and the dashed line meaning, both of which the honesty rule requires.
issues.fix: Add 'The y axis starts at 50%; the dashed line is the filter's clean-label accuracy.' to the caption.

strengths: Three-panel left-to-right structure with numbered circles and thick arrows tells problem, mechanism, result in order.
Our method is consistently purple in the network card, the bar and the legend; baselines have distinct muted hues.
Panel 3 uses bars with sd error bars and overlaid seed dots, legend above the plot and off the data.
Pooled precision bar gives the mechanism a concrete number, and crossed samples make the drop rule immediately readable.
